title: Forced marriage
reading: Love marriage: The couple who are going marry find each other themselves and decide to get married. Arranged marriage: The parents or family play an important role in finding a spouse for their children. The children accept their parents’ choice. Forced marriage: The parents find a spouse for their children and put pressure on them to marry. Forcing anyone to marry is illegal in Norway. Anyone forcing or pressuring someone to marry can be punished by imprisonment for a term of up to six years. Forced marriage is not valid under Norwegian law. Someone who is forced or pressured to marry can therefore go to a Norwegian court and get the marriage annulled. This must be done within five years of the marriage.
discussion: Talk together Are there clear boundaries between the three different types of marriage? Can people define force differently? Mina is 18 years old. She came to Norway with her parents when she was ten. She has just finished upper secondary school and is looking forward to studying. She has applied to take an engineering programme and is keen to find out whether she has got a place. She would like to get married and have children at some point in the future. She naturally wants to decide when she gets married and who she gets married to. However, her parents have started talking a lot about marriage. They are talking about a relative in their home country who would be perfect for Mina. Mina is not sleeping well. She respects her parents’ wishes, but also wants to decide over her own life. Discuss Mina’s situation. How do her parents see the situation? What would be the best solution for this family? GettyImages
exercises: Select the right answer When are you allowed to get married in Norway? When you are 16. When you are 18. When you are 20. Select the right answer Who can enter into a marriage? Only people of the opposite sex. Only people of the same sex. People of the opposite or same sex. Select the right answer What kind of marriage is characterised by the family playing an important role in finding a spouse for their children? forced marriage love marriage arranged marriage Select right or wrong Read the statements. What is right? What is wrong? Marriages must be entered into voluntarily. Right Wrong Anyone who threatens or forces someone to marry can be imprisoned for six years. Right Wrong Forced marriage is when parents and family play an important role in finding a spouse for their children. Right Wrong Forced marriage is legal in Norway. Right Wrong Love marriage is when two people find each other and decide to get married. Right Wrong Select the right answers Women and men have the same right to choose a spouse. If someone is forced to get married, the marriage can be annulled. Forcing anyone to marry is illegal in Norway. It is possible to remarry if you’re already married. You don’t need legal residence in Norway to get married here.
teacher_notes: Lærerinnhold Tips til undervisningen Snakk sammen Grensene mellom de tre typene ekteskap er flytende. Press og forventninger til å gifte seg (av og til med en spesiell kandidat) fra omgivelsene varierer fra kultur til kultur og fra familie og familie. Grensen mellom arrangert ekteskap og tvangsekteskap kan være ekstra vanskelig å trekke. Når blir forventing til press? Når blir press til tvang? Mina Diskusjonen her kan være ulik avhengig av deltakernes bakgrunn og kultur. Er dette en kjent situasjon for dem? Nyankomne kan kanskje reflektere rundt endringer i familien/barneoppdragelsen/barnas liv med bakgrunn i foreldrenes avgjørelse om å migrere. Foreldre flest vil det aller beste for barna sine. Men noen ganger kan hva foreldrene mener er det beste og hva barna mener er det beste komme på kollisjonskurs.
